# Golden test cases for internal/tabread, run through upstream's reader by
# reference/harness/tabread/gen.sh (results in golden.txt).
#
# Format: NAME MODE FILE [OPTION...]
#   MODE    trans (ib_read loop), sel (ib_readsel), app (ib_readapp);
#           every case is also dumped in mode "fields" (trd_read).
#   FILE    relative to this directory.
#   OPTION  -r/-f/-b/-C followed by a value in upstream escape notation
#           ('' is the empty string), or -w. Tokens never contain spaces
#           (write \x20).
# Lines starting with '#' and empty lines are ignored.

# upstream examples (fpgrowth/ex)
ex-test1                    trans ex/test1.tab
ex-test2                    trans ex/test2.tab -f ,.;:
ex-test2-default            trans ex/test2.tab
ex-test2-escaped-seps       trans ex/test2.tab -f \054\x2e\073:
ex-test3                    trans ex/test3.tab
ex-test3-weighted           trans ex/test3.tab -w
ex-test4                    trans ex/test4.tab
ex-test5                    trans ex/test5.tab
ex-test6                    trans ex/test6.tab
ex-test6pct                 trans input/test6pct.tab -r % -f \n -b \n
ex-test1csv                 trans ex/test1.csv
ex-test1csv-blank-comma     trans ex/test1.csv -b ,
ex-test1csv-blank-space-comma trans ex/test1.csv -b \x20,

# tokenizer rules
blanks                      trans input/blanks.txt
comments                    trans input/comments.txt
comments-disabled           trans input/comments.txt -C ''
crlf                        trans input/crlf.txt
crlf-cr-not-blank           trans input/crlf.txt -b \x20\t
cr-only                     trans input/cr-only.txt
empty                       trans input/empty.txt
newlines                    trans input/newlines.txt
no-final-newline            trans input/no-final-newline.txt
trailing-sep-eof            trans input/trailing-sep-eof.txt
trailing-sep-newline        trans input/trailing-sep-newline.txt
trailing-sep-blank-eof      trans input/trailing-sep-blank-eof.txt
trailing-blank-eof          trans input/trailing-blank-eof.txt
empty-field                 trans input/empty-field.txt
space-comma-space           trans input/space-comma-space.txt
nul                         trans input/nul-byte.txt
nul-last-field              trans input/nul-last-field.txt
nul-first-field             trans input/nul-first-field.txt
high-bytes                  trans input/high-bytes.txt
long-field                  trans input/long-field.txt
duplicates                  trans input/duplicates.txt
sep-overlap                 trans input/sep-overlap.txt -r \n; -f \x20;
tab-in-item                 trans input/tab-in-item.txt -f \x20
nul-sep                     trans input/nul-sep.txt -f \0
hash-data                   trans input/hash-data.txt -C ''
percent-comment             trans input/percent-comment.txt -C %;
semicolon-records           trans input/semicolon-records.txt -r ;

# transaction weights (-w)
weights                     trans input/weights.txt -w
weights-paren-blank         trans input/weights-paren-blank.txt -w -f ,
weights-nul                 trans input/weights-nul.txt -w
weights-big                 trans input/weights-big.txt -w
weights-neg                 trans input/weights-neg.txt -w
weights-overflow            trans input/weights-overflow.txt -w
weights-float               trans input/weights-float.txt -w
weights-letter              trans input/weights-letter.txt -w
weights-open                trans input/weights-open.txt -w
weights-mismatch            trans input/weights-mismatch.txt -w
weights-close               trans input/weights-close.txt -w
weights-hex-empty           trans input/weights-hex-empty.txt -w
weights-empty-line          trans input/weights-empty-line.txt -w
weights-trailing-sep        trans input/weights-trailing-sep.txt -w
weights-only-sign           trans input/weights-only-sign.txt -w
weights-empty-bracket       trans input/weights-empty-bracket.txt -w
weights-trailing-blank-eof  trans input/trailing-blank-eof.txt -w
weights-trailing-blank-after-field-eof trans input/trailing-blank-after-field-eof.txt -w

# item selection files (-R, item set targets)
sel                         sel input/sel.txt
sel-comment                 sel input/sel-comment.txt
sel-dup                     sel input/sel-dup.txt
sel-empty                   sel input/empty.txt
sel-trailing-sep-eof        sel input/sel-trailing-sep-eof.txt
sel-trailing-sep-newline    sel input/sel-trailing-sep-newline.txt
sel-nul                     sel input/sel-nul.txt

# item appearance files (-R, rule target)
app                         app input/app.txt
app-indicators              app input/app-indicators.txt
app-empty-first             app input/app-empty-first.txt
app-empty                   app input/app-empty.txt
app-two-first               app input/app-two-first.txt
app-no-indicator            app input/app-no-indicator.txt
app-three                   app input/app-three.txt
app-dup                     app input/app-dup.txt
app-dup-no-indicator        app input/app-dup-no-indicator.txt
app-unknown                 app input/app-unknown.txt
app-unknown-first           app input/app-unknown-first.txt
app-empty-record            app input/app-empty-record.txt
app-trailing-sep-eof        app input/app-trailing-sep-eof.txt
app-comment                 app input/app-comment.txt
